newsitem.title: GREECE: BASKETBALL-CHAMPIONS PANATHINAIKOS SLIP TO SHOCK HOME DEFEAT.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-CHAMPIONS PANATHINAIKOS SLIP TO SHOCK HOME DEFEAT.

text.p: Champions Panathinaikos slipped to a shock 72-66 home defeat at the hands of Villeurbanne of France in a group C EuroLeague basketball match on Wednesday.
The game was originally scheduled to take place in Villeurbanne but was shifted to Athens to avoid clashing with a major tennis tournament in France.
The switch seemed to do no favours for Panathinaikos who frittered an early 18-8 lead to trail 42-29 at halftime.
Villeurbanne's mercurial playmaker Delaney Rand notched 31 points, including five out of five triples, while Brian Howard added another valuable 14 points.
Nikos Economou (16) and Byron Dinkins (13) topscored for disappointing Panathinaikos who have now lost two of their first three EuroLeague matches.
It was a good effort from the French team, making it two wins out of three despite the absence of injured American Ronnie Smith, who is out for the rest of the season.
In another Greek-French clash, former European champions Limoges lost their third group A match in succession as Panionios swept to 92-77 victory.
Barcelona, who had been pace-setters in group C, suffered their first defeat of the series when they lost 77-65 to Olimpija Ljubljana in Slovenia.
They now share top place with Olimpija and Villeurbanne, each with two wins and one defeat.
